response.justification: While Bogdan has strong full-stack and systems engineering experience, including exposure to event-driven systems and some AI-agent tooling, he lacks demonstrable production-scale experience in multi-agent AI architectures for fintech, regulatory-compliant AI systems, or leadership of engineering teams beyond 10 people — all core requirements for this CTO role.
strengths: Hands-on experience with event-driven systems and microservices in high-throughput environments.
Demonstrated contributions to AI-agent tooling (MCP code generators) and open-source infrastructure.
Strong engineering discipline with TDD, CI/CD, and developer tooling expertise.
concerns: No evidence of designing or operating multi-agent AI systems in regulated fintech contexts.
Lacks leadership experience scaling teams from 10 to 30+ or building senior technical leadership layers.
No demonstrated experience with real-time credit risk, working-capital algorithms, or financial compliance infrastructure.
